messages:
vik: Quick huddle: refining auto-fallback UX for noisy saturation. need to decide what belongs in the 1-line summary.

anya: 1-line: action + score + top signal + small affordance (preview/override). e.g. "Auto-fallback triggered · score 64 · p95 1.9s · [preview]"

mike: Also add tiny cost hint: "~ -18% cost". Keep it subtle so it doesn't bias ops.

vik: about triggers: prefer OR'd primary signals (p95, error-rate) + an explicit cooldown to avoid thrash. allow optional prefilters (ignore if origin_host_change > 40%).

anya: operator override options: hold for 15m, pin until next deploy, and force-revert. each requires short reason and writes immutable audit entry.

telemetry-bot: note: adding fields fallback.audit_id, fallback.saturation_score, fallback.primary_signal, fallback.preview_url to schema.

mike: dry-run feature: show last 6h simulated flips and toggles for burst_capture. backend returns sample flip timestamps + snapshots. UI shows mini sparkline with flip markers.

vik: retention defaults: playback-ready traces 14 days, archive 0.5% long-term. ops can request extensions.

anya: UX todo: build compact modal with preview + policy JSON view + override buttons. will mock later today.

mike: I'll expose /simulate and attach audit snapshot hash to every flip.

vik: cool. please drop any weirdness (single-host errors, A/B traffic surges) so we can add prefilter rules.

anya: flagged: add skip-if-single-host-dominant and require_two_signals option.

telemetry-bot: action: ticket INF-900 created for indexing fallback.saturation_score.

vik: thanks team — wrap up in PRs next week.
